description: Semantic free-text search over the companies you have already discovered. Does not run a new discovery and does not cost credits. Returns LEAN prospect SUMMARIES (domain, name, industry, size, location, employee_count, logo, a short description and a semantic_score) — not the full record. To get every field for one company (contacts, emails, registry data, social profiles, ...), call get_prospect(domain) with the summary's `domain`. Pagination is progressive: the response carries `has_more` and an opaque `next_cursor`; pass that cursor back to fetch the next page. When `has_more` is false / `next_cursor` is null you have seen everything above the relevance floor — stop paging.
name: search_prospects
title: Search prospects
